Impact analysis: who depends on these files, and the tests to run again.

```text
Queries the map and shows, for one or more files, who depends on them — always the side that
depends: whoever imports it or declares @dep of it, reads what it writes, captures it,
realizes it; for a spec, the code, feature and tests it rules.

  • Direct — what depends on the file itself (the default).
  • --propagate indirect — one level further: what depends on the direct ones.
  • --propagate cascade  — the whole chain, up to @noPropagation nodes.

Each item past the first level carries the path that ties it to the file, and an item many
others depend on says how many it pulls: judge whether that branch belongs (--stop-at
<glob> lists it and climbs no further from it). The tests to run again are those reached
and those whose evidence closure holds a reached file — what evidence-fresh judges —, by the
layer of the suite that runs them.

  • Validates against — what the file is confronted with (its spec, feature, guides).

  --format text    grouped by level and layer (default)
  --format files   the tests to run again, one per line (with --layer, one layer's)
  --format json    levels, paths, tests and rulers

Query only — it opens no issue and changes nothing.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors impact <file>... [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `text` | text \| files \| json |
| `--layer` |  | only the tests of this layer (the `layer:` of a suite in `tests:`) |
| `--map` |  | path to the map (default: <root>/anchors.graph.yaml) |
| `--propagate` |  | past the direct level: indirect (one level more) or cascade (the whole chain) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--stop-at` |  | glob of nodes listed but not walked past (repeatable or comma-separated) |

## Confronting the project — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors check`](/docs/cli/commands/check/) | Run the quality gates (the pipeline) |
| [`anchors verify`](/docs/cli/commands/verify/) | Run EVERYTHING the phase requires: Anchors gates + external tools |
| [`anchors coverage`](/docs/cli/commands/coverage/) | Show coverage by scenario, by line, of the DIFF and the delta |
| [`anchors stale`](/docs/cli/commands/stale/) | List stale edges — what changed and has not been reconfronted |
| [`anchors affected-tests`](/docs/cli/commands/affected-tests/) | List the tests a change can break — by rule and region where the project declares them |
| **`anchors impact`** | Impact analysis: who depends on these files, and the tests to run again |
| [`anchors dependencies`](/docs/cli/commands/dependencies/) | What these files depend on — impact the other way |
| [`anchors failures`](/docs/cli/commands/failures/) | The observed failures that the spec has not yet explained |
